dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge displays a smooth, shallow concave spline curvature from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse shape classification and a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin slope is approximately 40 degrees relative to the dorsal horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Dorsal fin base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.7:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Melon profile fits a wide-radius convex arc with a smooth surface boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Rostrum is short and thick with a low length-to-base-width pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle at the inflection point where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan/turquoise pigmentation across the entire visible dermal surface.
